query:
-- 查詢最早的 10 筆記錄
(SELECT 
  'OLDEST' as position,
  ph.price,
  ph.soldAt,
  ph.createdAt,
  COALESCE(ph.soldAt, ph.createdAt) as effectiveDate,
  DATEDIFF(NOW(), COALESCE(ph.soldAt, ph.createdAt)) as daysAgo
FROM priceHistory ph
JOIN cards c ON ph.cardId = c.id
WHERE c.name LIKE '%Japanese National Team%'
  AND ph.grade = 'PSA10'
ORDER BY COALESCE(ph.soldAt, ph.createdAt) ASC
LIMIT 5)

UNION ALL

(SELECT 
  'NEWEST' as position,
  ph.price,
  ph.soldAt,
  ph.createdAt,
  COALESCE(ph.soldAt, ph.createdAt) as effectiveDate,
  DATEDIFF(NOW(), COALESCE(ph.soldAt, ph.createdAt)) as daysAgo
FROM priceHistory ph
JOIN cards c ON ph.cardId = c.id
WHERE c.name LIKE '%Japanese National Team%'
  AND ph.grade = 'PSA10'
ORDER BY COALESCE(ph.soldAt, ph.createdAt) DESC
LIMIT 5);
